metadata.title: Unknotting number and L-space satellite operations
metadata.abstract: We give a lower bound for the unknotting number under the L-space satellite operations. In the case of braided L-space satellite operations, including cabling operations, we obtain a stronger bound. The proof uses a lower bound for the unknotting number in knot Floer homology due to Alishahi-Eftekhary. The computational tool is a formula for computing the knot Floer complex under the L-space satellite operations, which was defined in the authors' previous work.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 加强 L-space 卫星结的解结数下界，特别涉及编织卫星与缆结。
techniques: 结 Floer 复形的卫星公式
analysis.breakthrough: 将已有复形计算转化为更强的具体解结数阻碍。
analysis.limitations: 依赖卫星及 L-space 等条件；给出下界不必意味着算出精确解结数。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。AI 披露另见独立核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: Floer 不变量对经典结复杂度的应用清楚，适合低维拓扑专题。
